title: Series B and The War on Bugs
summary: We have raised a $50M Series B led by Menlo Ventures. The round values the company at $750M.
body_markdown:
We have raised a $50M Series B led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Jump Trading, Wing, Operator Collective, Benchmark, YC, Browder Capital, and Initialized. The round values the company at $750M. Deedy Das is joining our board.


Greptile reviews and tests more than 1% of all PRs opened on GitHub every day. We have become the code validator for thousands of engineering teams including Nvidia, Coinbase, Decagon, and Vanta.


The best companies use multiple coding agents and run all their changes through Greptile, which acts as a single, independent validation layer. We’ve made progress, but there is a lot of work ahead of us.


---


AI’s promise depends on being able to trust the code it produces. While coding is orders of magnitude faster than before, the impact on a team’s ability to ship new features at work has been modest. Engineers still need to determine whether a change works as intended and if it will break something for users.


[At Greptile, our mission is to automate code validation](https://www.greptile.com/blog/automating-code-validation) so even teams building mission-critical software can auto-merge complex changes.


If we succeed, these teams will see the true promise of AI coding for the first time.


If the problems we’re working on sound interesting,[we’d love to hear from you](https://www.greptile.com/careers) .
